name: Karrie International Holdings Limited
summary: Karrie International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells metal, plastic, and electronic products in Hong Kong, Japan, Mainland China, Asia, North America, and Western Europe. It operates through Metal and Plastic Business and Electronic Manufacturing Services Business segments.
